name: wolf3d-monorepo
description: A collection of Wolfenstein 3D builds — retail, source-compiled, and modified — each playable in the browser via js-dos, with a launcher homepage.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names home,retail,source,modified,ts --prefix-colors green,yellow,cyan,magenta,blue npm:dev:home npm:dev:dos-page npm:dev:source-dos npm:dev:source-modified-dos npm:dev:source-typescript
scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:source-typescript-port && npm run check:demo-traces && npm run check:save-data && npm run check:frame && npm run check:gameplay-frame && npm run check:present && npm run check:palette && npm run check:palette-shift && npm run check:pause && npm run check:deathspin && npm run check:fizzle && npm run check:mouse && npm run check:digi-sound && npm run check:music && npm run check:victory && npm run check:opl && npm run check:opl-pitch && npm run check:opl-synth && npm run check:opl-worklet && npm run check:intro-screens && npm run check:sound-menu && npm run check:confirm && npm run check:endscreens && npm run check:highscores && npm run check:saveload-roundtrip && npm run check:demo-playback && npm run check:loadsave-screen && npm run check:browser
scripts.preview: concurrently --names home,retail,source,modified,ts --prefix-colors green,yellow,cyan,magenta,blue npm:preview:home npm:preview:dos-page npm:preview:source-dos npm:preview:source-modified-dos npm:preview:source-typescript
